llm_response.reason: The website offers standard products (flower bouquets), lists normal pricing, references a longstanding company history (since 1908), and provides all required legal and privacy documentation as typical of legitimate German businesses. There is no evidence of scam characteristics such as unrealistic offers, requests for deposits, fake testimonials, urgency tactics, spoofing, or unusual payment methods.
